headline: NBU Corrects Exchange Rates After Glitch: What the Dollar and Euro Will Cost on September 8
summary: The National Bank of Ukraine announced corrected exchange rates after a technical error, setting the dollar and euro rates for September 8.
why: The National Bank of Ukraine is the country's central bank and publishes the official rates used across the economy. Errors in published rates matter for currency pricing and settlement.
